title: Mediterranean Chickpea Pilaf
description: A flavorful pilaf dish with chickpeas, inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine. This quick and easy recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add uncooked pilaf, chickpeas, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the pilaf is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
